title: Multiple MPC Controllers
text: Simulate switching between multiple implicit MPC controllers, 14 inputs, 7 outputs, {Block data type} sets data type of manipulated variables; {Cell Array of MPC Controllers} sets the candidate controllers cell array of mpc, {Cell Array of Initial Controller States} sets the initial state cell array of mpcstate, {Measured disturbances} adds measured disturbance input port, {External manipulated variable} adds external manipulated variable input, {Targets for manipulated variables} adds manipulated variable target input port, {Optimal cost} adds optimal cost output port, {Optimization status} adds optimization status output port, {Estimated controller states} adds estimated states output port, {Optimal control sequence} adds optimal control sequence output port, {Optimal state sequence} adds optimal state sequence output port, {Optimal output sequence} adds optimal output sequence output port, {Use custom state estimation instead of using the built-in Kalman filter} uses custom state estimate input port, {Lower OV limits} adds minimum OV constraint input port, {Upper OV limits} adds maximum OV constraint input port, {Lower MV limits} adds minimum MV constraint input port, {Upper MV limits} adds maximum MV constraint input port, {Custom constraints} adds custom constraints input ports, {OV weights} adds OV tuning weights input port, {MV weights} adds MV tuning weights input port, {MVRate weights} adds MV rate tuning weights input port, {Slack variable weight} adds ECR tuning weight input port and {Inherit sample time} sets the inherit block sample time from parent. Values come from the instance.
